provenance.dataset: CMS 2016 Open Data, Tau Run2016G+H, NanoAODv9 (records 30532, 30565)
provenance.fit_tool: TRExFitter v1.8.0, profile-likelihood fit of m_tt (MET-likelihood di-tau mass) in 3 BDT categories x 14 bins, tautau_SR0 fitted above 110 GeV only (DropBins 1-7), 39 NPs + 42 gammas
provenance.units: cross sections in pb; grouped impacts and uncertainties on mu_Z are relative fractions (not %)

poi.name: mu_Z
poi.reference: aMC@NLO DYJetsToLL_M-50 fiducial template, sigma(Z/gamma* -> ll, m > 50) = 6077.22/3 pb per flavour

sigma_fid.definition: pp -> Z/gamma* -> tau tau, both tau hadronic, visible tau pT > 40 GeV, |eta| < 2.1, 60 < m_LHE < 120 GeV

sigma_60_120.definition: sigma(Z/gamma* -> tau tau, 60 < m_LHE < 120 GeV) = mu_Z x sigma^pred(60-120); err_up/down = syst (+) stat (MINOS); acc = the acceptance uncertainty (3.7 %), quoted separately, not printed

ranking_note: output/results.json fit.mcsub.ranking, top 12 by post-fit impact; impact_up/down are the shifts of mu_Z
plots_note: prefit = mu_Z = 1 templates (Plots/*_prefit.yaml, negative bins already clamped to 0 in the fit inputs); postfit = best-fit NPs and mu_Z; total uncertainty band from the same yaml
